# Spirit Energy

> > Family-run renewable energy specialist providing solar PV, battery storage, and EV charging solutions for residential and commercial clients across the UK since 2010.

Spirit Energy offers comprehensive renewable energy services including solar panel installation, battery storage systems (Tesla Powerwall 3, SolaX), EV charging infrastructure, and commercial consultancy. The company provides design, installation, and ongoing support with expertise in grid integration, DNO permissions, and government grant schemes.

## Key Topics

- Solar PV installation
- Battery storage systems
- EV charging infrastructure
- Tesla Powerwall 3
- SolaX inverters
- Commercial energy solutions
- Workplace Charging Scheme
- DNO grid permissions
- In-roof solar panels
- Solar PPA (Power Purchase Agreements)
- Residential renewable energy
- Commercial battery storage
- Peak demand avoidance
- Renewable energy consultancy
